description: A ground-level photograph depicting a dense urban area, identified as "Continuous Urban fabric IM.D. (Palermo, Spain)". The image features numerous multi-story residential buildings with distinct dark grey pitched roofs and multiple dormer windows. Facades of the buildings are varied, showing colours such as pink, light blue, and various shades of white and grey. Some trees and green areas are visible in the foreground and between buildings, suggesting areas not entirely sealed. The sky is overcast. The image is credited to M. Escobar and serves to illustrate aspects of urban land cover and Imperviousness Density (IMD), particularly within predominant residential usage contexts.
